2609.00065.title: Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents
2609.00065.paper_summary: A language-model agent asked to analyse an experiment will usually return working code. Whether the analysis is defensible is a different question. A defensible analysis depends on procedural choices: which test the field accepts, which identifier namespace is authoritative, and which caveats must accompany a result. We present Scientific Agent Skills, an open library of 163 such procedures in 16 areas of practice, including genomics, cheminformatics, medical imaging, study design and scientific communication. Each skill is a directory built around a versioned, human-readable instruction file. An agent loads the file only when a task calls for it; the directory often also contains reference material and runnable scripts. We report no task-level evaluation and no host selection rate. Openly licensed and available at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills.
2609.00065.paper_summary_zh: 一個被要求分析實驗的語言模型代理通常會返回可運行的代碼。分析是否合理是另一個問題。一個合理的分析取決於程序選擇：該領域接受哪個測試，哪個標識符命名空間是權威的，以及哪些警告必須伴隨結果。我們提出了科學代理技能，這是一個開放的庫，包含16個實踐領域中的163個此類程序，包括基因組學、化學信息學、醫學影像、研究設計和科學交流。每個技能都是圍繞一個版本化的人類可讀指令文件構建的目錄。代理僅在任務需要時加載該文件；該目錄通常還包含參考材料和可運行的腳本。我們報告沒有任務級別的評估和沒有主機選擇率。該庫是公開授權的，並可在 https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills 獲得。
